concept: ferry attendant reconstructs who crossed the landing
ownership: All case circumstances, investigator profession, witness, ferry location, objects and gates below are agent-authored experimental expectations. Reference input supplies visible face/hair guidance only; no actual identity, age, role, temperament or biography is inferred.
meaning_target: Investigative fiction should read through an active request for case information and an observable witness response, beyond a generic conversation or portrait.
scene: At a closed riverside ferry ticket booth after the last crossing, a fictional investigator asks an attendant about a person shown in a printed search photograph. The attendant traces the route on a landing diagram, and the investigator pauses a note to follow the new information.

precore_direction_comparison.direction: portraits across a bare interview desk
precore_direction_comparison.assessment: Clear two-person focus but the source of information and why this particular witness knows it would be weak.

precore_direction_comparison.direction: ticket-booth canvass with photograph, diagram and a shared pointing target
precore_direction_comparison.assessment: Chosen. The working place establishes opportunity to observe, the photograph supplies the case target, and a fingertip on the diagram supplies a specific response.

gates.attention: investigator gaze follows the attendant and the indicated point
gates.document_or_prop: printed search photograph paired with notebook and pen
gates.visibility: both faces, relevant hands and case materials readable in same frame
gates.pass_rule: The image visibly combines inquiry material, directed attention and recording or paused recording; casual counter transaction alone fails.

gates.target: one marked landing on the map shared across counter
gates.attention: attendant engaged with investigator and map
gates.document_or_prop: simple landing diagram with a prominent dock branch
gates.contact: attendant fingertip visibly touches the dock branch
gates.visibility: continuous forearm, fingertip and its map contact visible
gates.pass_rule: Witness gives specific spatial information to the investigator; hovering or disconnected hand fails.

gates.attention: photo angled toward attendant, still readable to viewer
gates.document_or_prop: recognizable portrait photograph distinct from blank paper
gates.contact: held by investigator left hand at its lower edge
gates.visibility: portrait surface and holding contact visible simultaneously
gates.pass_rule: A person is recognizably represented and shown for identification, not merely an unspecified card.

gates.attention: all support the same canvassing encounter
gates.document_or_prop: ticket booth counter, ferry window/landing diagram, empty gangway outside
gates.visibility: booth work context and landing both sufficiently visible
gates.pass_rule: The site explains why this witness could supply crossing information; generic office context fails.

gates.attention: face turned enough to assess features
gates.visibility: face and short dark bob visible
gates.pass_rule: Face/hair recognizably track reference cues; no claim of real identity is made.

gates.attention: their gazes and gestures form a connected exchange
gates.document_or_prop: photo, notebook, map serve distinct purposes
gates.contact: photo hold and map touch each coherent
gates.pass_rule: All C1–C4 relations must pass. Partial or unobservable components fail the full gate.

competing_reading: A routine ferry ticket purchase or travel advice exchange; the identification portrait plus active case notes must visibly defeat this reading.
image_call_budget: one native call; identical-input retry only for explicitly recorded provider transient/block within skill authorization
